Demand and sales forecasting

Shows expected sales for the coming weeks per branch and product, so there is less dead stock and fewer items run out. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 96 mln; the full version in 14–24 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 6–10 weeksFull 14–24 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 96–181 mln $8,000–15,000Full UZS 260–605 mln $22,000–50,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012
Per month
UZS 0.6–4 mln your own running costs: hosting, SMS and other services
Difficulty
medium
Who it is for
Retail, Distribution and wholesale, Pharmacies, Restaurants and cafes, Manufacturing, Agriculture
Integrations
  • 1C
  • Google Sheets
  • LLM API

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Forecast for top products from 1–3 years of sales history
  • Seasonality (Ramadan, Navruz, school season, wedding season)
  • Accuracy check against real sales
  • Excel or dashboard output
What the full version adds
  • All products and branches
  • Purchase suggestions with minimum stock and supplier lead times
  • Effect of promotions and prices
  • Weekly automatic retraining
  • Results written back to 1C

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
